meta.title: Castlefolk — Build. Rule. Conquer.
meta.description: A relaxed pixel-art strategy game: build a kingdom, command real-time battles, sail to new shores and face rival kingdoms that play by the same rules as you. 22 maps, 5 campaigns and a built-in map editor.
meta.ogAlt: A Castlefolk settlement surrounded by forest, with knights massed on the grass

hero.lede: Build a settlement, feed your people, raise an army and sail out to take a crown, in a relaxed real-time strategy game that never rushes you.
hero.madeWith: A pixel-art strategy game made by Peikko Labs
hero.imageAlt: A Castlefolk village of stone and timber houses beside the sea, with squads of knights and spearmen on the grass

pitch.heading: A kingdom, from one small settlement

build.title: Build & grow
build.text: Start with a small settlement and grow it into a kingdom, one house, tower and castle at a time.

gather.title: Gather & feed
gather.text: Harvest wood, herd sheep and mine gold. Everyone eats and every building has upkeep, so a bigger kingdom needs bigger supplies.

army.title: Raise your army
army.text: Train pawns into warriors, archers, lancers and monks, and keep them fed, healed and out of trouble.

conquer.title: Sail & conquer
conquer.text: Fight monsters and rival kingdoms, on land and across the sea, for control of the map.

build.title: Build
build.text: Construct castles, houses, barracks, towers, monasteries and more. Every building you raise changes what your settlement can do next.
build.imageAlt: The build menu open over a settlement, with a rival castle visible in the distance

manage.title: Manage
manage.text: Balance population, housing, supply and military strength. Every soldier you train is a worker who stops gathering, and everyone has to eat.
manage.imageAlt: The barracks interface with garrison slots and a unit training progress bar

command.title: Command
command.text: Orders stick: units see them through, and you can see every one on the map. Order a whole territory cleared or harvested, and save groups to hotkeys.
command.imageAlt: A player drag-selecting squads of knights with a selection rectangle

fight.title: Fight
fight.text: Command your forces in real-time battles against monsters and rival lords. Position matters as much as numbers.
fight.imageAlt: Knights fighting skeleton warriors and a minotaur across a wooden bridge

sail.title: Sail
sail.text: Load up to six units onto a boat and cross the water. Fight from the deck, land on a hostile shore, and expect rival kingdoms to come at you by sea too.
sail.imageAlt: A small boat carrying two pawns towards an island held by skeleton warriors

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.text: Five campaigns across 17 maps, from your first humble settlement to the landing at Hastings, the field of Clontarf, the rock of Mont-Saint-Michel and the roads of Gaul. Plus five standalone maps for a quick game.

create.title: Create
create.text: Draw your own world in the built-in map editor, with islands, plateaus, bridges, creatures and rival kingdoms. Share it as a single file, and play maps made by others.

conquer.title: Conquer
conquer.text: Turn a tiny settlement into a kingdom capable of ruling the entire world. Rival kingdoms gather, build and raid by the same rules as you, so every win is earned.
conquer.imageAlt: A large army of knights, spearmen and archers formed up on open grass

world.heading: A world worth ruling
world.lede: Castlefolk is played at kingdom scale. Beyond your walls there are forests to clear, coastlines to settle, rival lords to outgrow — and things in the wilderness that will happily eat a lone woodcutter.

map.title: One map, many claims
map.text: Zoom out to the parchment map to see the whole world: your territory, your rival's, and everything still unclaimed between them.
map.imageAlt: The parchment strategy map with green and purple territories marked

monsters.title: The wilderness bites back
monsters.text: Goblins, trolls, gnolls and worse hold the ground you want. Some of them are a nuisance. Some of them end an expedition.
monsters.imageAlt: Skeleton warriors and a minotaur defending an island across a bridge

highlands.title: Cliffs and high ground
highlands.text: Plateaus with cliffs and narrow stairs turn ridges into fortresses. A ridge is only as strong as its one staircase.
highlands.imageAlt: Terraced plateaus with cliff walls, where units are fighting scarecrows

roadmap.heading: In development
roadmap.lede: Castlefolk is being built in the open. Everything ticked works in the game today; the open circles are ideas we plan to build. No dates — it is ready when it is good.

cta.heading: Your kingdom awaits.
cta.text: Build your settlement. Raise your army. Sail across the water. Take the crown.
cta.note: Wishlisting tells us people want this, and reminds you the day it launches.
